scope: Stock Elite and Pro target instructions after the modeled SPL handoff, with timed SPI/LCD and emulated IRQ, audio and SPI flash. Does not measure physical hardware.
procedure: Six fresh processes per model: create a package-derived seed, capture the two splashes separately, run to ordinary UI with each initial image, cold-boot from the recovered result. The fixture compiles the same sample_sector/seed_splash C bodies as the seven-case replay. FM1_STRICT=1, empty FM1_BENCH_KEYS, --mhz 360 --lcd-only, no device connection.
checks: Compare every panel-order RGB565 value against the existing host splash or ordinary screen. Compare all 1 MiB of flash before and after accounting for only the specified live/shadow sectors. Read boot/IRQ counters, zone and published loop count at their supplied ELF symbols.
